data.title: Bitcoin and double taxation: the reform proposals at the center of the debate
data.text: During the Bitcoin Conference 2025, Senator Cynthia Lummis reopened an open wound regarding the double taxation imposed on Bitcoin miners. Bitcoin miners and other participants in the digital ecosystem are facing a serious issue of double taxation in the United States. As highlighted by Senator Lummis, those involved in mining are taxed twice: first, at the time of receiving the block rewards (that is, the rewards in Bitcoin obtained from validating transactions on the blockchain) and, subsequently, upon the sale of the accumulated assets. This dynamic creates a significant financial burden, especially considering that the value of Bitcoin can change rapidly between the time of receipt and the time of sale.

data.title: Bitcoin funding rate: analysis of changes and impact on the market
data.text: Bitcoin funding rate represents one of the most monitored tools in the universe of crypto derivatives, a central element that in recent years has radically changed balances, strategies, and opportunities for traders and institutional operators. The reflection on the evolution of the Bitcoin perpetual swap market, especially through the lens of the funding rates of XBTUSD on BitMEX, shows a constantly transforming context that influences both the volatility and the profitability of investments. At the core of the crypto derivatives revolution are the perpetual swaps, financial instruments first introduced by BitMEX, designed to allow exposure to Bitcoin without having to trade the underlying asset directly or worry about expirations. Central to perpetual swaps is the funding rate: a periodic payment mechanism between those holding long and short positions, designed to keep the swap contract price in line with the spot price.
